import os,sys,json
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
from tools.common import ROOT,read_json,write_json,file_sha256,machine_id,utc_now,_replace_json
folder=ROOT/'runtime/rolling-review-queue';target=folder/'slot-b.json';temporary=folder/'slot-b.json.tmp';before=read_json(target);pending=read_json(temporary)
phasep=ROOT/'runtime/root-b-review-v24-phase.json';phase=read_json(phasep)
assert before['status']=='available' and before['sequence']==176 and pending['status']=='assigned' and pending['sequence']==177 and pending['tag']=='rollingb177'
assert pending['slot']=='b' and pending['machine_id']==machine_id() and phase['current_tag'] is None
assert pending['manifest_sha256']==file_sha256(ROOT/pending['manifest'])
jobs=read_json(ROOT/pending['jobs']);manifest=read_json(ROOT/pending['manifest']);entries=[e for p in manifest['pages'] for e in p['entries']]
assert [e['source_sha256'] for e in entries]==[j['key'] for j in jobs]==pending['source_keys'] and len(entries)==4
rows=read_json(ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/generated.json')['portraits'];reservations=[]
for e in entries:
 key=e['source_sha256'];digest=e['generated_fullsize_sha256'];assert rows[key]['generated_fullsize_sha256']==digest
 rp=folder/'reservations/visible-alpha-v1'/(key+'-'+digest+'.json');reservation=read_json(rp)
 assert reservation['slot']=='b' and reservation['machine_id']==machine_id() and reservation['generated_fullsize_sha256']==digest
 reservations.append({'path':rp.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix(),'sha256':file_sha256(rp),'exact':reservation})
assert not (ROOT/pending['report']).exists() and not (ROOT/pending['config']).exists()
audit=ROOT/'mod_nailong/data/production-owner-failures/20261026-root-b177-atomic-claim-reconciliation.json';assert not audit.exists()
write_json(audit,{'machine_id':machine_id(),'observed_at_utc':utc_now(),'previous_slot_exact':before,'previous_phase_exact':phase,'preserved_pending_slot_exact':pending,'preserved_pending_slot_sha256':file_sha256(temporary),'manifest_sha256':file_sha256(ROOT/pending['manifest']),'actual_reservations':reservations,'actual_failed_tool_output':read_json(ROOT/'runtime/rollingb177-failed-claim-tool-output.json'),'scope':'WinError1175 occurred only while atomically publishing final slot state. No new claim, generation, source reservation, output decision or canonical journal replay.','source_code':Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8')})
lock=folder/'allocation.lock';fd=os.open(lock,os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY)
try:
 assert read_json(target)==before and read_json(temporary)==pending and read_json(phasep)==phase
 _replace_json(temporary,target)
 assert read_json(target)==pending
 phase.update(current_tag=pending['tag'],current_kind='portrait',allocated_at_utc=pending['claimed_at_utc'],allocation_reconciled_at_utc=utc_now(),allocation_reconciliation=audit.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix());write_json(phasep,phase)
 result={'kind':'portrait','allocation':{'ready':True,**pending},'finite_phase_summary':{k:phase.get(k) for k in ['deadline_utc','completed_groups','current_kind','current_tag']}}
 write_json(ROOT/'runtime/root-b-last-allocation-v24-recovered-b177.json',result)
finally:os.close(fd);lock.unlink()
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=True),flush=True)
